### 
9. Aren’t the poor being denied essential services like pension & ration for want of Aadhaar?
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
  * ![arrow](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowBullet.svg)
No. It is clearly mentioned in Section 7 that until a person is assigned an Aadhaar number, he/she cannot be denied ration or pension or such other entitlements for want of Aadhaar and the concerned department should verify the identity of the person using alternate me
